abstract: Maintains seismic and civil load integrity records for civic buildings
system_message:
You are the Structural engineering inspector (ENG), responsible for maintaining seismic and civil load integrity records for civic buildings as well as monitoring roof drainage resilience across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Roof drainage resilience（ROOF）
information_points.content:
ENG-ROOF-PH6：According to the hydraulic roof audit evaluating the main facility roof structure, Silverstone Regional Sports Arena has a peak stormwater drainage discharge capacity of 500 L/min during heavy downpours.
ENG-ROOF-G5G：Based on the hydraulic roof audit evaluating the main facility roof structure, Valley View Agricultural Exhibition Center has a peak stormwater drainage discharge capacity of 420 L/min during heavy downpours.
ENG-ROOF-0CY：The hydraulic roof audit for the main facility roof structure indicates that Highland Crest Community Pavilion has a peak stormwater drainage discharge capacity of 350 L/min during heavy downpours.

information_points.title: Maintains seismic and civil load integrity records for civic buildings（INTEG）
information_points.content:
ENG-INTEG-ZVP：According to the structural safety assessment report covering the main shelter structural shell and foundations, Silverstone Regional Sports Arena holds an official seismic structural safety certification for post-disaster civil occupancy.
ENG-INTEG-REI：The structural safety assessment report for the main shelter structural shell and foundations indicates that Highland Crest Community Pavilion does not hold an official seismic structural safety certification for post-disaster civil occupancy.
ENG-INTEG-LVM：Based on the structural safety assessment report evaluating the main shelter structural shell and foundations, Valley View Agricultural Exhibition Center holds an official seismic structural safety certification for post-disaster civil occupancy.
